_comment: In-run merge shepherd (distinct from the standalone pr-shepherd daemon). Per-transaction authority: claims one merge bead, lands or bounces, releases. Enforced at stop: holds zero claims. It legitimately writes merge_sha/pr and closes merge beads. deny_states blocks review verdicts. deny_metadata omits branch/base_sha because those are pre-existing merge-bead anchors and the evaluator cannot attribute field authorship.
